componentRendering.htmlCssSnippets: Intentionally empty: native SwiftUI/AppKit controls and materials are not HTML/CSS components. The sidecar does not claim web panel fidelity.
componentRendering.colorSerialization: Native semantic selectors are authoritative. No approximate CSS palette or synthesized tonal ramps are introduced.
componentRendering.detectorApplicability: No HTML/CSS detector result is applicable to these native source files.

evidence.captureMethod: WindowServer captures of owned inactive fixture windows with synthetic data, never physical-mouse acceptance.
evidence.assetChanges: Existing app icon and slogan retained; no generated raster assets.

components.name: Settings navigation
components.description: Native buttons with subtle selected fill, uniform symbol slots, keyboard movement and selected accessibility state.

components.name: Aligned sizing form
components.description: Native sliders and editable values; 108 pt label column, 20 pt gap, 81 pt value column.

components.name: Fixed-zoom Dock preview
components.description: 190 pt card, 50/75/100% zoom, one metrics line, real geometry and scrollable overflow.

narrative.overview: User-approved November 17 draft implemented in native SwiftUI/AppKit. Semantic macOS colors and system fonts remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Single fixed-zoom preview above aligned form rows
Progressive disclosure and explicit per-screen scope

rules.name: Fixed preview scale
rules.body: Never auto-fit when the user changes Dock size. Show the actual resolved size separately from the requested size.

rules.name: Preserve settings
rules.body: UI layout changes must not reset existing groups, dimensions, permissions, overrides or per-display positions.

dos: Use native controls and semantic colors.
Check compact, dark, advanced, system-follow and overflow states.
donts: Do not replace native settings with a web view.
Do not infer physical-mouse acceptance from fixtures.
